title: attributeStorageInfo
description: The attributeStorageInfo object describes the structure of the binary attribute data resource of a layer, which is the same for every node in the layer. The following examples show how different attribute types are represented as a binary buffer. # Examples of attribute resources

header.description: Declares the headers of the binary attribute data.

ordering.description: Possible values for each array string: `attributeByteCounts`: Should only be present when working with string data types. `attributeValues`: Should always be present. `ObjectIds`

attributeValues.description: Represents the description for value encoding. For example: scalar or vector encoding.

attributeByteCounts.description: For string types only. Represents the byte count of the string, including the null character.

objectIds.description: Stores the object-id values of each feature within the node.
